clue: Bartender left burning candle at both ends on old road
explanation: LANDLORD: bartender. L (left), ANDL (burning candle at both ends), on O (old) RD (road).
hints: Left can often be represented by a single letter.
So can old, while road is often shortened to just two.
What letters remain if you burn CANDLE at both ends?
The answer will be a word that can mean "bartender" (perhaps in a slightly dated sense).
